steps.label: Prompt
steps.text:
Make a 21-second logo reveal for [your product], 16:9 at 1920x1080, from the "19-lowpoly-logo-reveal" template in lumian2015/opus-5-5-video-templates (MIT, rendered with HyperFrames).

Setup: clone https://github.com/lumian2015/opus-5-5-video-templates into ~/.claude/skills/opus-5-5-video-templates, then run `npx hyperframes@0.8.96 doctor` and fix anything it reports (it needs Node.js 22 or newer, FFmpeg and Chrome).

The film, scene by scene:
1. wireframe of the mark draws itself from the bottom vertex, node by node
2. 65 facets fly in with spin and motion trails and land from the bottom up
3. glow, bloom and an expanding double ring
4. the app tile grows behind the mark and the real logo resolves over the low-poly version
5. the icon moves into a lockup, the wordmark is typed with a caret, subtitle fades in

Before you change anything, learn [your product] from [your product URL] and ask me only for what you cannot find: its name, what it does in one line, the copy each scene needs, and two or three brand colours as #rrggbb. The demo brand, names, prices, numbers, ratings and quotes are placeholders: replace every one with something true for my product, or remove it. Never ship a made-up number or testimonial.

Then:
1. `node ~/.claude/skills/opus-5-5-video-templates/scripts/new-video.mjs 19-lowpoly-logo-reveal my-video`
2. `node ~/.claude/skills/opus-5-5-video-templates/scripts/vars.mjs my-video` to list the variables.
3. Write values.json, keeping each value close to its default's length and format (the same number of |-separated items, plain numbers where the default is a number), then apply it with `node ~/.claude/skills/opus-5-5-video-templates/scripts/vars.mjs my-video values.json`.
4. `cd my-video && npx hyperframes@0.8.96 snapshot --at 1,7,14,20`, look at every frame, and fix any text that overflows or any colour that is hard to read.
5. `npx hyperframes@0.8.96 render -f 60 -q high -w 4 -o out.mp4`, then watch it through once before you hand it over.

Template notes: The mark lives in assets/mesh.js, generated by tools/mesh.py from assets/logo.png (the warm logo proposed with the site restyle). To use the purple production logo: copy public/logo.png to assets/logo.png, rerun `uv run --with pillow python3 tools/mesh.py assets/logo.png > assets/mesh.js`, and set tile to #0f0f2a. For another brand, replace PTS and FACETS in tools/mesh.py with that mark's faces.
